charts.title: L 98-59 c: orbits around L 98-59
charts.description: The orbits of L 98-59's planets in this map from above, to scale, with L 98-59 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Schwarz et al. 2026 (2026AN....34770059S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SCHWARZ_ET_AL_2026): P 3.69057404 d
